packageRules.description: Group minor updates for review (prod scope by default)
Auto-merge dev-scope minor updates after cooldown
Auto-merge GitHub Actions digest updates after cooldown
Pin PSR to v10 — block Renovate downgrades
Hold pydantic-settings below 2.15 until the MCP SDK rebuilds Settings

Cap pydantic <3. core-py and embedding-daemon deliberately declare a wide >=2.12.5,<3 so consumers can resolve whatever pydantic they already run; core-py's comment states the intent as 'no 2.13 lock-in'. Renovate may therefore move only the lock file, never the declared floor: update-lockfile takes in-range updates into uv.lock and leaves pyproject alone. History of this rule: pin (wrong — rewrote the deps to == and forced every consumer onto one build), then bump (still wrong — raised the floor to >=2.13.4, which is exactly the lock-in the comment rules out), now update-lockfile. embedding-daemon used to hold at <2.13 so cohere-using consumers could resolve, but cohere 7.x lifted that pin (pydantic-core <3.0.0) and the stack no longer depends on the cohere SDK directly.

description: Do not set commitMessagePrefix here. semanticCommitType + semanticCommitScope already produce the exact same 'fix(deps):' string (CommitMessage.formatPrefix appends the colon), so it adds nothing -- but Renovate only computes the prefix, and only sets its internal toLowerCase flag, inside `if (semanticCommits === 'enabled' && !commitMessagePrefix)`. Setting it therefore silently disables the lowercasing that commitMessageLowerCase='auto' is supposed to do. That went unnoticed because our own commitMessageAction ('update') is already lowercase; the presets' are not -- lockFileMaintenance uses 'Lock file maintenance', pin/pinDigest use 'Pin', rollback 'Roll back', replacement 'Replace'. Each of those produced a title starting with a capital, which the CI job 'Validate PR title' rejects (subjectPattern ^(?![A-Z]).+$), so the bot PR was born red and could never automerge. Seen on #715.

The top-level semanticCommitType: 'fix' below does NOT reliably apply -- packageRules always win over top-level scalars for the fields they touch, and config:recommended extends :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers, whose packageRules are [{matchPackageNames: ['*'], semanticCommitType: 'chore'}, {matchDepTypes: ['dependencies','require'], semanticCommitType: 'fix'}, ...]. Renovate applies packageRules in array order and the last match wins per field (proved by reading the installed renovate package's resolveConfigPresets/applyPackageRules/mergeChildConfig directly, not assumed): our own extends and packageRules are merged in AFTER config:recommended's, but the wildcard chore rule matches every dep, and the dependencies/require rule only re-covers prod deps -- so any devDependency (e.g. @types/better-sqlite3) never gets re-matched back to fix and keeps 'chore', which the 'Validate PR title' job rejects (repo only allows fix/feat). Fixed by appending ':semanticCommitTypeAll(fix)' to extends: that preset's packageRule (matchFileNames: ['**/*'] -> semanticCommitType: 'fix') is merged in after config:recommended's, so it is the last match for every dependency regardless of depType, and wins. Seen on #724.
